name: 01-open
text: Property moves fast. Your next conversation should start with the right context.

name: 02-sellers
text: Meet Repeat A I. Bring your sellers together from Google Sheets and Excel.

name: 03-market
text: Follow the buildings you cover, and spot asking-price changes worth a conversation.

name: 04-ask
text: Need an answer? Just ask Repeat. Talk, or type.

name: 05-request
text: Show me the latest price drops.

name: 06-message
text: Keep it personal. Start with your own words, and turn them into a WhatsApp follow-up for each seller.

name: 07-schedule
text: Then plan your week by building. Choose what to follow up, and when.

name: 08-tools
text: Connect your email and calendars. And work with Claude or Chat G P T, through M C P.

name: 09-platforms
text: At your desk, or between viewings. Keep going across web, Windows, and mobile.

name: 10-close
text: Less admin. Better conversations. Repeat A I.
